## Definition of done
- [ ] The one thing this change is for works, on a real phone where it is user-facing
- [ ] Every state has copy: empty, loading, error, success
- [ ] Tokens only (no raw hex); light and dark checked; contrast verified
- [ ] Keyboard-only walkthrough passes; focus visible; reduced motion respected
- [ ] Within budgets: weight, Lighthouse, fonts
- [ ] No secrets; security headers set; admin routes protected; inputs validated on the server
- [ ] CI is green and the secrets scan is green
- [ ] Release note written; I know which version to roll back to
